command.openSettings.title: Simple Excel Editor: Open Settings
command.newFile.title: Simple Excel Editor: New Excel File
config.nullMarkers.description: Strings treated as NULL. Use [null] to match DBRider's ReplacementDataSet.
config.emptyMarkers.description: Strings treated as empty string. Use [empty] to match DBRider's ReplacementDataSet.
config.pageSize.description: Number of rows to display per page.
config.hasHeader.description: Treat the first row as a header row.
config.enableRowGrouping.description: Enable row grouping. Enter values in [group name] format in blank-header columns to group rows with the same value.
config.language.description: UI language. "auto" follows the VS Code display language. Set to "en" or "ja" to override.
